title: Explaining Complex Systems Clearly
summary: Defining technical concepts, explaining processes, and adapting explanations to an audience.
whyItMatters: A strong explanation gives the audience a usable mental model without hiding limitations or drowning them in terminology.

mentalModel.title: Purpose before mechanism
mentalModel.content: Begin with what the system does and why it matters, then explain key components.

mentalModel.title: Layer detail progressively
mentalModel.content: Offer a simple model first and add technical precision only when needed.

ruleBlocks.title: Define terms through category and distinction
ruleBlocks.content: State what the concept is and how it differs from nearby concepts.

ruleBlocks.title: Explain input, transformation, and output
ruleBlocks.content: Use a stable sequence and indicate feedback or human intervention.

ruleBlocks.title: Check understanding and limitations
ruleBlocks.content: Invite questions, test the model with an example, and name exceptions.

examples.de: Vereinfacht gesagt erkennt das Modell Muster in vorhandenen Daten.
examples.en: Simply put, the model recognizes patterns in existing data.

examples.de: Zunächst werden Daten verarbeitet; anschließend erzeugt das System eine Ausgabe.
examples.en: First data is processed; the system then generates an output.

examples.de: Die Analogie hilft beim Einstieg, bildet den technischen Prozess aber nicht vollständig ab.
examples.en: The analogy helps as an introduction but does not fully represent the technical process.

commonMistakes.correct: Establish purpose and a simple model first.
commonMistakes.reason: The audience needs orientation before detail.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use an analogy without naming its limits.
commonMistakes.correct: Explain where the comparison stops working.
